title: How the Insects Got Their Colors
summary: A group of insect friends comes to a colorful flower garden and decides to become colorful too. Which color will each one choose?
pages: "Friends, let's go to the flower garden," says Butterfly.

"Oh! Look at all the flowers here!" says Butterfly.
"Let's be colorful like them."

"I'll mix red and yellow," says Rhinoceros Beetle.
"That makes orange. Now I'm orange."

"I'll mix blue and yellow," says Grasshopper.
"That makes green. Now I'm green."

"I'll mix red and blue," says Butterfly.
"That makes purple. Now I'm purple."
"I want to be colorful like my friends," says Caterpillar.
"That's not hard at all," says Bee. "We'll help you."
"Oh! I have seven colors," says Caterpillar.
